Hugging Face Space

Paid
Docker Spaces (greyed out on a new account) · no card

A Space has a public https address, so fleet could call one with no tunnel. That is why we looked, but see the catch.

Catch: On a new free account on 2026-11-13 the Docker option and CPU Basic hardware were greyed out with a "Paid" badge, so we could not make one. Static and Gradio Spaces are free but cannot run fleetd.

Northflank Sandbox

Not tried
2 services, 1 database, always on (vendor figures) · no card

The best free candidate we found: its pricing page marks the Sandbox plan "No card needed" and "Always on, no sleeping", and it has an API.

Catch: Not tried by us yet. Its FAQ says a card you enter is only verified, so check at sign-up that it is not asked for. Limited compute.

SnapDeploy free

Limited
4 containers, 0.25 vCPU, 512 MB, 100 hours a month · no card

Says no card; runs a Docker image.<
